end.parentNote: Asha practised multiplying by 10 and 100, focusing on the number of zeros and place value. Sameer used the correct transformation of doubling one factor and halving the other, then found 50 × 12 = 600 by splitting 12 into 10 and 2. They mixed up the zero rule in some examples and did not yet correct the idea of doubling both factors; at home, practise with place-value charts and examples such as 25 × 16.
